marketLayer.title: US Mega-Cap Tech & AI Infrastructure
marketLayer.fact: US major tech earnings showed robust growth in enterprise cloud revenue driven by generative AI hardware and data center deployments.
marketLayer.inference: Continued high capital expenditure supports semiconductor vendors and global hardware suppliers listed in both US and HK markets.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Pace of software monetization relative to heavy capital expenditure returns.

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Tech Index & Southbound Capital
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index recorded strong net inflows via Southbound Stock Connect, particularly targeting major e-commerce and social platform equities.
marketLayer.inference: Improved liquidity cushions valuation floors for HK-listed internet majors amid stabilization in domestic policy signals.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Sustained momentum in Chinese domestic consumption metrics and retail sales recovery.

marketLayer.title: US Federal Reserve Rate Policy Dynamics
marketLayer.fact: Recent US labor and inflation indicators signaled moderate economic cooling, reinforcing market expectations for upcoming interest rate reductions.
marketLayer.inference: Easing rate expectations lower discount rates for high-duration growth stocks and alleviate capital outflow pressure on HK dollar assets.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential commodity price spikes or sticky core service inflation altering the Fed path.

marketLayer.title: Global Electric Vehicle & Battery Sector
marketLayer.fact: Leading Chinese and US EV manufacturers announced expanded promotional incentives alongside accelerated international market pushes.
marketLayer.inference: Margin compression risks remain acute for downstream OEMs, favoring upstream suppliers with diversified global customer bases.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Evolving trade policies, tariffs, and localized regulatory hurdles in key import regions.
